title: Arizona frat suspended after allegedly making new recruits swallow live goldfish
description:
Case of alleged hazing at the University of Arizona is latest in series of controversial incidents involving US fraternities

A college fraternity at the University of Arizona has been suspended after new members were allegedly plied with alcohol and forced to swallow live goldfish.

College officials informed the university’s Sigma Tau Gamma chapter by letter earlier in September that it was under investigation for multiple alleged violations of the student code of conduct, including “endangering, threatening, or causing physical harm” to members of the campus community.
